Three AI consulting firms to put on an RFP shortlist

A shortlist is useful when the procurement team can explain why each firm is in the room. Choose the bidder whose public delivery evidence resembles the work you are buying. Send the same acceptance scenario to everyone invited to quote.

We chose these examples for the specific work documented in a client case or product guide. Client outcomes are provider-reported. AY Automate publishes this guide.

  1. Capgemini · Enterprise process automation

    Capgemini’s ZF case describes a global RPA service. It is a relevant reference when several business units need a common operating model. In the RFP, ask which decisions the central team owns and which stay with a local process owner. Request one example of an automation rejected during discovery.

    Read the source from Capgemini

  2. WeAreBrain · ERP and supplier coordination

    WeAreBrain describes automating supplier notifications and case updates for Truck Tyre Assist with ERP partner DooIT. Ask both who built the integration and who supports it. During evaluation, have the bidder trace a declined supplier request through reassignment and customer notification.

    Read the source from WeAreBrain

  3. Slalom · Customer support operations

    Slalom’s Genie case identifies the client, the support function and a rollout involving 180 agents. Ask the delivery lead which parts of a comparable bid cover training, queue configuration and post-launch support. Price those separately so a cheaper prototype is easy to spot alongside a fully staffed rollout.

    Read the source from Slalom

What to ask before you buy

  1. Ask for named delivery leads, their allocation and any subcontracted work.
  2. Request a reference in a similar operating environment. Ask the client what happened after go-live.
  3. Require a sample statement of work with acceptance criteria, data handling and exit rights.

Directory

Evaluate each firm as a bidder. Give finalists the same scenario and request documentary evidence for staffing, commercial scope and acceptance. Record an unanswered condition separately from a scored answer.

Published by AY Automate, which sells AI implementation services. Entries link to provider materials. The guide gives no numerical ratings.

Enterprise delivery

Accenture

Publishes an AI services offering under the Texas DIR contract. Request the proposed statement of work and ask the bidder to map each mandatory requirement to its contract clause.

Source from Accenture

Enterprise transformation

BCG

Combines strategy and applied AI. Ask which executive sponsor and delivery lead would answer an escalation. Score the named team attending the bid review.

Source from BCG

Process automation

Capgemini

Documents the rollout of a global robotic process automation service at ZF. Request a reference for a program spanning multiple business units and ask what the client had to supply during rollout.

Source from Capgemini

Engineering and data

Deloitte

Groups engineering, AI and data delivery in one practice. Give the bid team a sample data-quality exception. Score the proposed ownership and cost of remediation.

Source from Deloitte

Technology integration

IBM Consulting

Offers artificial intelligence consulting. Request the responsibilities of the consulting team and software partners separately, including the support boundary.

Source from IBM Consulting

Analytics and operating model

McKinsey QuantumBlack

Describes a hybrid intelligence approach. Have the bid team show how an operations owner can challenge a model recommendation and record the ruling.

Source from McKinsey QuantumBlack

AI implementation

Slalom

Describes AI consulting for enterprise teams. Ask for the rollout lead to attend the reference interview. Compare promised training with what the named client received.

Source from Slalom

Workflow implementation

AY Automate

Builds AI automations and publishes delivery case studies. Ask which party owns the labeled examples and how the bidder will document reviewer overrides during acceptance.

Source from AY Automate

Workflow integration

WeAreBrain

Offers workflow automation and integration. Require a responsibility table for the agency and its ERP partner. Ask who handles incidents spanning both systems.

Source from WeAreBrain

Low-code delivery

LowCode Agency

Publishes a guide to AI agents that run business processes. For a low-code bid, request export rights, platform fees and access rules in the same commercial response.

Source from LowCode Agency

How to compare prices

Ask for role-level rates, a milestone estimate and change-order terms. Normalize proposals to the same team size and time horizon before scoring cost.

A worked example to review

Accenture’s Texas DIR AI services page identifies contract DIR-CPO-5153 and directs eligible customers to the service agreement in Appendix D. Use this as an example of a procurement artifact: compare the advertised service categories with the deliverables, assumptions and acceptance conditions in the actual statement of work.

Read the provider’s example

How many consulting firms should reach the final round?

Choose a group small enough to review thoroughly. Three comparable proposals can expose differences in staffing, commercial terms and support obligations.
